policy: Evidence Cards describe observed properties and known gaps; they are not safety guarantees.

integrity.basis: installer records SHA-256 for every copied file and doctor verifies the recorded hashes

security.notes: Security Gate v1 scans bundled artifacts for blocking patterns; informational signals remain visible for human review.

compatibility.evidence: open Agent Skills structure plus Codex project/user target adapter
open Agent Skills structure plus Cursor project/user target adapter
CLI prepares files for manual upload; it does not claim direct ChatGPT Web installation

recommendation.reason: Bundled, source-reviewed and integrity-checked; dedicated task-level end-to-end evidence is still incomplete.

openai-agents-sdk-builder.name: OpenAI Agents SDK Builder
openai-agents-sdk-builder.summary: Scaffolds a minimal Agents SDK project and guides production hardening.

permissions.local_files: writes scaffold files in a user-selected target
permissions.network: none during scaffolding; generated app uses OpenAI API when later run
permissions.secrets: does not read secrets; generated app expects OPENAI_API_KEY
permissions.destructive_actions: --force can overwrite generated files in the selected target

usefulness.evidence: scaffolder creates app.py, requirements.txt, .env.example and README.md deterministically

known_gaps: No dedicated end-to-end task fixture against a live Agents SDK environment yet.

realtime-api-integration.name: Realtime API Integration
realtime-api-integration.summary: Creates a starter for Realtime API transport design with browser/server separation and fallback guidance.

permissions.network: none during scaffolding; generated server uses OpenAI Realtime when later run
permissions.secrets: does not read secrets; generated server expects OPENAI_API_KEY
permissions.destructive_actions: writes named files in the selected target

usefulness.evidence: scaffolder emits a deterministic starter and transport plan

known_gaps: No dedicated end-to-end WebRTC/WebSocket fixture against a live Realtime session yet.

chatgpt-apps-deployer.name: ChatGPT Apps Deployer
chatgpt-apps-deployer.summary: Builds a deterministic release manifest for a ChatGPT app project without implying platform approval.

permissions.local_files: recursively reads project files and writes a release manifest
permissions.destructive_actions: overwrites the configured manifest output path

usefulness.evidence: deterministic SHA-256 manifest generation is directly executable without external credentials

known_gaps: Does not submit or approve an app in ChatGPT; deployment remains a separate platform action.

codex-pr-reviewer.name: Codex PR Reviewer
codex-pr-reviewer.summary: Builds a deterministic review prompt from versioned business rules and severities.

permissions.local_files: reads a JSON rules file and writes one Markdown prompt

usefulness.evidence: rule validation and deterministic prompt generation are directly executable

known_gaps: Does not itself fetch or review a pull request; Codex or another review surface performs that step.

cs-navigator.name: CS Navigator
cs-navigator.summary: Turns a plain-language job into the smallest evidence-backed ChatGPT Skills recommendation using a versioned local catalog snapshot.

permissions.local_files: none required by the chat-native workflow; it reads only its bundled reference snapshot through the skill runtime

usefulness.evidence: navigation rules, source-preserving trust boundaries and deterministic catalog snapshot are validated in CI

known_gaps: End-to-end recommendation behavior inside a qualifying ChatGPT Skills surface has not yet been promoted from designed to tested.
The bundled snapshot is intentionally finite and can report a coverage gap when a job is not represented.
